comment: Approved exceptions to the Sub feature freeze (docs/FEATURE_FREEZE.md). Every entry requires approved_by=michaelayoade and is reviewed via CODEOWNERS on this file. kinds: feature-exception (must name starter_contract), schema (corrective migration), transitional-tool (must name deletion_trigger), approved-growth (owner-approved pinned-surface growth, no new capability).

exceptions.reason: Michael explicitly approved Sub #3624 and its scoped thin-client exception on 2026-10-14 (merged 2fd54e6d; recorded in Knowledge dotmac-billing-cutover-orchestration-2026-10-14 v9): net +232 billing lines on the same 137-file inventory (92265 -> 92497), of which +175 in three existing transitional opening-evidence tools and +57 of repair-CLI freeze guards in existing scripts. No new capability, no new files. This entry reconciles the ratchet baseline deliberately to the accepted source; it does not authorize further growth.
exceptions.deletion_trigger: Transitional opening-evidence tools delete at the opening seal (see billing_transitional_tools.json); this exception entry is removed when the baseline next shrinks past 92265.

exceptions.reason: Michael explicitly approved this scoped exception for PR #3630 on 2026-10-14. It covers only the listed network control-plane composition and router-control modules; CODEOWNERS review of this file remains required before merge.

exceptions.reason: Michael explicitly approved the scoped exception for Sub PR #3640 at 189d0722a38a92602dc6843653a9f00af92f51e9 on 2026-10-15. Owner: financial.payment_intent_module_shadow; steward: finance operations. Actual production growth is 246 lines: 151 adapter, 5 caller, 6 metrics and 84 SOT declaration. This covers only a read-only consumer of the published Payments intent contract, with no settlement authority, cap relaxation or additional capability. Source merge requires current green CI and separate billing-owner approval.
exceptions.starter_contract: Published dotmac-payments 0.1.0a2 GetPaymentIntentV1 / get_payment_intent_v1: caller-owned tenant-scoped Session, persisted immutable intent binding observation, no autoflush or settlement authority.
exceptions.deletion_trigger: Delete the adapter, caller hook, metric, SOT entry and this exception when approved Payments ownership and complete backfill/parity permit retirement of legacy checkout bindings.

exceptions.reason: Michael directed the thin-client health goal on 2026-10-16: keep the existing poller/syslog probes and product semantics Sub-local, serialize Starter Platform Health observations at the source edge, and create no Sub health subsystem or deployment authority. He approved commit, push and draft PR #3655 for hosted CI. This entry covers only the listed bounded serialization module; modifications to the existing probe owners need no exception. CODEOWNERS review of this file remains required before merge.
exceptions.starter_contract: Starter dotmac-platform-health HealthObservationInput: source_ref, observation_key, component_code, healthy/degraded/unhealthy/unknown state, observed_at, received_at, summary and bounded labels; Platform Health remains the future sole durable observation/evidence owner and Integrator remains the authenticated transport boundary.

exceptions.reason: Michael directed on 2026-10-17 (money-pack cutover session): full cutover to Starter related modules, billing policies composable with defaults, no hardcoding, composable policies with settings. This exempts one new composition-wiring module that resolves the Starter billing issuance policy surface (account-ref convention at Subscriber granularity for linked radio/fiber accounts, obligation identity templates, tax/due/numbering/document-profile defaults) from domain settings with typed defaults. No writer is wired by the exempted PR; issuance switching remains a separately approved slice. The billing thin-client ratchet baseline grows deliberately by this module only and resumes shrinking as writers retire.
exceptions.starter_contract: Published dotmac-billing 0.1.0a8 issuance contracts: IssueRatedInvoiceV1 / AcceptRatedObligationV1 / DueDateBasisV1 / AppliedTaxSnapshotV1 and create_billing_account (external_account_ref + currency get-or-create), consumed as composition wiring only.

exceptions.reason: Michael approved the money-pack cutover continuation on 2026-10-17 (merge approval for the thin-client slice stack after confirming the composable-policy direction, ADR 0031). Slice 6a issuance switching needs a structural Sub<->Starter invoice link (ADR 0007 forbids metadata as financial identity): one tenant-scoped table recording, per Sub invoice, the Starter billing account, obligation and document identities. Schema-only change; no writer behavior changes in the exempted PR, and the table retires with the legacy Invoice writer at cutover seal.
exceptions.starter_contract: Published dotmac-billing 0.1.0a8 issuance receipts: IssuedRatedInvoiceV1 (billing_account_id, obligation_id, invoice_id) persisted as the structural link target; Starter remains sole ledger authority once the slice gate passes.

exceptions.reason: Schema half of THIN-STARTER-INVOICE-LINK (Michael approved the money-pack cutover continuation and merges on 2026-10-18): migration 691 creates the tenant-scoped starter_invoice_links table, the structural Sub<->Starter invoice identity link required by Slice 6a issuance switching (ADR 0007/0031). Corrective composition schema only; no writer behavior changes in the exempted PR.

Michael approved the money-pack cutover continuation and merges on 2026-10-18 under the confirmed composable-policy direction (ADR 0031). Slice 6a adds the thin-client issuance composition module that routes eligible admin drafts (web detail Issue: postpaid, single-line, quantity-one, undiscounted, non-proforma, complete party evidence) through Starter dotmac-billing as sole ledger writer, mirroring number/status onto the Sub row with a structural link. This is consumer wiring for a published Starter contract; the legacy writer keeps every ineligible lane until its own slice. Policy surface grows deliberately under ADR 0031 and shrinks as legacy writers retire. The SOT registry path is covered because the lane must declare its canonical owner (financial.starter_issuance) in the financial-access registry before the architecture liveness guard accepts the new writer.
exceptions.starter_contract: Published dotmac-billing 0.1.0a8 issue_rated_invoice + create_billing_account + get_invoice_document_fact, and dotmac-numbering 0.1.0a3 allocate/configure_series, consumed exactly as registered in the commercial composition import allowlist.

exceptions.reason: Michael approved the money-pack cutover continuation and merges on 2026-10-18 under the confirmed composable-policy direction (ADR 0031) and the pay-then-record constraint for the renewal pay link. This slice completes the settlement back-half for Starter-issued invoices: an authenticated provider webhook records confirmation in Starter dotmac-payments, Starter dotmac-billing accepts and allocates the confirmed cash against the Starter document, and Sub mirrors balance/status from the Starter collectible position. No legacy Payment is created for Starter-linked invoices and no billing logic is built in Sub; the legacy provider-event money staging keeps every non-Starter lane until its own slice. Settlement policy values resolve from settings under ADR 0031.
exceptions.starter_contract: Published dotmac-payments 0.1.0a3 get_payment_intent_v1 + record_confirmation + get_confirmed_cash_v1, and dotmac-billing 0.1.0a8 accept_settlement + allocate_settlement + get_current_receivable_position, consumed exactly as registered in the commercial composition import allowlist.

exceptions.reason: Michael approved the money-pack cutover continuation and merges on 2026-10-18 under the confirmed composable-policy direction (ADR 0031), including running remaining steps in parallel. This slice extends the Slice 6a web-detail Issue switch from single-line to homogeneous multi-line admin drafts (accept-per-line plus create_multi_line_draft_document plus issue_document, the composition proven in #3681), still with Starter dotmac-billing as sole ledger writer and the Sub row as mirror plus structural links. Eligibility remains pre-write and a Starter refusal never falls back to the legacy writer.
exceptions.starter_contract: Published dotmac-billing 0.1.0a8 accept_rated_obligation + create_multi_line_draft_document + issue_document, and dotmac-numbering 0.1.0a3 allocate/configure_series, consumed exactly as registered in the commercial composition import allowlist.

exceptions.reason: Migration 692 adds starter_invoice_line_links (per-line Starter obligation identity) and makes starter_invoice_links.obligation_id nullable, because a multi-line Starter document carries one obligation per line while the invoice-level link holds account and document identity only. Structural identity only (ADR 0007); retires with the legacy Invoice writer.

Michael directed Step 5 (opening-balance rehearsal) to run in parallel with the remaining Step 4 lanes on 2026-10-18. This adds the read-only census-to-observation assembly that translates Sub's opening census preview onto the pinned dotmac-billing rehearsal observation contract, field for field, so rehearsal runs can count blockers into the manual exceptions queue. It verifies nothing, qualifies no cash, invents no originals, and writes no money state; manifest/command assembly and verifiers follow as their own slices.
exceptions.deletion_trigger: Delete after the opening import is sealed in dotmac-billing and the final rehearsal artifact is archived.

exceptions.reason: Step 5 (opening-balance rehearsal) continues in parallel at Michael's direction. Starter's read-only rehearsal adapter consumes Sub's serialized opening census (sub-billing-opening-census-v2/-v3 JSON), which Sub does not yet emit. This adds a pure evidence renderer that serializes the typed census preview (BillingOpeningExportPreviewV3) to that exact wire document field for field, with Decimals as exact strings. It verifies nothing, qualifies no cash, invents no originals, and writes no money state.
exceptions.deletion_trigger: Delete after the opening import is sealed in dotmac-billing and the final rehearsal artifact is archived.

exceptions.reason: Next Step 4 caller-migration lane after the admin issuance slices (6a #3691, multi-line #3697): switch the scheduled invoice cycle's newly created postpaid invoices to Starter issuance at end-of-run. The cycle stages drafts, appends lines, then issues eligible groups (single-subscription homogeneous line sets, no available account credit) through the existing starter_issuance service; ineligible groups keep the legacy issuance path. A reuse guard excludes Starter-linked invoices from the cycle's existing-invoice line appends. Sub remains caller-only: no new billing logic, no dual-write. The account_credit path carries the structural guard excluding Starter-linked invoices from legacy account-credit settlement.
exceptions.starter_contract: Published dotmac-billing 0.1.0a8 issue_rated_invoice + accept_rated_obligation + create_multi_line_draft_document + issue_document + create_billing_account, and dotmac-numbering 0.1.0a3 allocate/configure_series, consumed exactly as registered in the commercial composition import allowlist.

exceptions.reason: Michael explicitly approved Sub #3699 on 2026-10-19 under the freeze carve-out 'root-cause the settlement auto-repair' (PAID-NOT-REACTIVATED 2026-10-18, SUB-005060): +62 money-writer lines (TOTAL 24013 -> 24075) in one existing file. A prepaid draft whose billing_period_end precedes the funding event, or which has no service period, no longer receives new funding; it is recorded once (insert-if-absent) in prepaid_draft_reconciliation_exceptions for manual review and the existing current-period renewal proceeds. No new money path, migration or data repair; no further growth authorized.
exceptions.deletion_trigger: Remove when prepaid funding/renewal moves to Starter dotmac-billing (ADR 0020) and prepaid_draft_reconciliation.py is retired, or when the money-writer baseline next shrinks below 24013.

exceptions.reason: Step 4 caller migration: credit notes against Starter-issued invoices are issued by pinned dotmac-billing as sole ledger writer through a new thin-client module; the legacy credit-note writer keeps only non-Starter invoices. Eligibility is structural (the invoice carries a StarterInvoiceLink) and decided before any write; Sub remains caller-only.
exceptions.starter_contract: Published dotmac-billing 0.1.0a8 issue_credit_note and dotmac-numbering 0.1.0a3 allocate/configure_series, consumed exactly as registered in the commercial composition import allowlist.

exceptions.reason: Step 4 caller migration: staff-recorded manual payments and account-credit applications against Starter-issued invoices settle through dotmac-payments confirmation into dotmac-billing (pay-then-record), never through legacy money writers. Legacy credit application to Starter receivables is closed structurally; Sub remains caller-only.
exceptions.starter_contract: Published dotmac-payments 0.1.0a3 record_confirmation + get_confirmed_cash_v1 and dotmac-billing 0.1.0a8 accept_settlement + allocate_settlement + credit-lane commands, consumed exactly as registered in the commercial composition import allowlist.

exceptions.reason: Step 4 reader repoint: for Starter-issued invoices, balance/position reads, invoice PDF facts, and reporting read the Starter ledger position and document fact instead of legacy projections. Read-only lane; legacy invoices keep legacy readers until cutover.
exceptions.starter_contract: Published dotmac-billing 0.1.0a8 get_current_receivable_position + get_invoice_document_fact, consumed exactly as registered in the commercial composition import allowlist.

exceptions.reason: Step 4 caller migration, gated by the ADR 0032 incident acceptance tests at the Starter boundary (a payment bound to one intent cannot settle another obligation; full settlement yields exactly one access signal even when replayed; only the access owner switches service). Prepaid renewals then fund and issue through Starter earmarks and advance-collection issuance; Sub remains caller-only and the legacy prepaid writers retire under the ratchet.
exceptions.starter_contract: Published dotmac-billing 0.1.0a8 earmark commands + issue_rated_invoice (advance collection) + accept/allocate settlement, and dotmac-payments 0.1.0a3 intent-bound confirmation, consumed exactly as registered in the commercial composition import allowlist.

exceptions.reason: Structural identity storage for the credits and readers lanes (ADR 0007: no metadata as financial identity): starter_credit_note_links records the Starter credit document identity for credit notes issued through dotmac-billing, and starter_invoice_links gains the issued document fact version so readers can read the exact frozen document fact. Identity only, never financial state.

Michael approved 2026-10-19 landing the reviewed open branches via one integration PR (#3716) instead of 17 separate merges: Learning/Kernel party and operator-tenant imports (#3672-#3678), audit visibility fixes (#3660/#3661), billing kill-switch and ingestion split (#3708/#3709), and small fixes (#3631-#3635, #3671). The combined diff exceeds the per-PR size threshold and adds two kernel-import modules plus one audit template; each constituent branch was reviewed on its own PR. No new capability beyond those branches.
exceptions.starter_contract: Starter kernel party-identity and operator-tenancy import contracts consumed by party_kernel_import/operator_tenant_kernel_import (Learning/Kernel #3672-#3678); remaining paths are corrections to existing Sub audit/admin surfaces (#3660/#3661, #3708/#3709, #3631-#3635, #3671) landed under the same approval, consuming no new Starter contract.

exceptions.reason: Michael approved option C on 2026-10-19 (D3 ended-service credential may be inherited by the same customer only; D6 new permission subscription:credential:update; D7 disconnect after RADIUS projection). Minimal Sub bridge until the Starter access-credentials owner exists: setting-gated inherit of a replacement service's credential (default 'new', behaviour unchanged until flipped), reactivation keeps the existing password, typed create-form login/password honoured, and the edit path corrected to touch only this service's credential, remove the old username from RADIUS, disconnect only after projection succeeds and surface failure. No new Python module, no new template, no OpenAPI change. The workflow guidance gate also requires a one-line guidance update in app/services/admin_workflow_guidance.py. The review follow-ups also touch the existing secret-reference guard readers (access_credential_secret, radius, radius_population, customer_authentication, test_connection, web_customer_details, cpe_dialer_credential_reconcile, provisioning_enforcement); they add no capability.
exceptions.starter_contract: proposed dotmac-access-credentials on_replacement_service / inherit_from_service_states / change_disconnect policy keys (ADR-00NN, pending); the bridge settings map 1:1 and the bridge branch is deleted at the Starter cutover.

exceptions.reason: Permission-only migration registering subscription:credential:update (Michael decision D6, 2026-10-19): the credential edit path currently has no dedicated permission, so any actor holding subscription:update can rename or re-password a PPPoE credential. No tables, no role grants; additive and reversible unless operators have assigned it. Exact path; it is updated if the migration is renumbered on merge order.
